_doc: security-hardening 10, F4: what reaches each front-door route's upstream, per identity header. removed: dropped from the request. replaced: the ext_authz check's 200 always carries it, and Envoy overwrites the client's value. kept: passed through. Read by nix/portal/envoy-spec.nix (rendered by test/portal-envoy/portal_envoy.py) and by the gate's Rust tests (Route::replaced), so a header added to the gate is one new row here. x-agent-session-id is replaced on rpc (S31): the check sets the token's own sid, so the portal in cookie mode names no session and a client's value never reaches the agent.
